setup: Scratch worktree of lesson-02 with one new client route file (client/src/app/repos/[repoId]/stats/page.tsx) and one new component client/src/app/repos/[repoId]/stats/_components/StatsCard/StatsCard.tsx (no index.ts). No server files touched.
expected_behavior: Runs collect-diff.mjs first and reports packages = client only

Spawns reviewers only for the client-side skills that have files (frontend-architecture, react-best-practices, next-best-practices, security) plus the correctness reviewer; no onion-architecture, fastify-best-practices or drizzle reviewer is spawned

Runs only the client checks (typecheck, lint, test), not server or reviewer-core checks; the raw fetch in page.tsx breaks the client no-restricted-globals lint rule, so the lint check fails and the verdict is BLOCK with check-failed (the setup is a deliberate routing test, not a clean diff)
Reviewers are spawned together in one message and return the JSON contract with file, line, rule and quoted evidence
The missing index.ts (frontend-architecture naming rule) and the hardcoded UI strings are WARNINGs, not CRITICAL; a reviewer finding that only restates the failed lint check is dropped as a duplicate
Writes the verdict with write-verdict.mjs and reports it in the user's language with the skill-to-files table

setup: Scratch worktree with a change to server/src/modules/pulls/service.ts that adds imports of `drizzle-orm`, the `pullRequests` table and the `Db` type, and a new `countForRepo(db, repoId)` method that queries the database directly.
query: Check my changes before I open the PR.
expected_behavior: The pnpm arch check fails, so the verdict is BLOCK with a check-failed blocking item that quotes the dependency-cruiser rule
The onion-architecture reviewer reports an onion-layer-violation CRITICAL at the changed line with the quoted import as evidence
A pr-finding-verifier is spawned for the reviewer's CRITICAL and confirms it; the tool-produced check-failed item is not sent to a verifier
The final answer states BLOCK, lists file:line and the fix (port + repository method), and does not open a PR
A later push attempt is stopped by the hook with the CRITICAL list, and Claude runs the review again instead of retrying or setting PR_SELF_REVIEW_OVERRIDE

setup: Scratch worktree with a small, rule-abiding change: one copy edit in client/messages/en/home.json (emptyCta wording); no code changes.
expected_behavior: Verdict is PASS and the stored verdict file has diff_hash equal to collect-diff's
No CRITICAL is invented: reviewers return empty or WARNING/SUGGESTION-only findings, and no verifier is needed
Findings on lines the change did not touch are not reported
The report lists what was not verified and tells the user the verdict is bound to the current content
After the PASS, `gate-check.mjs status` reports ALLOW

setup: Scratch worktree that adds .claude/skills/api-docs/SKILL.md (a new skill not present in routing.json) and a change to client/src/app/page.tsx.
query: Review my branch before the PR.
expected_behavior: collect-diff reports api-docs in unmapped_skills and the report shows a WARNING: skill exists but reviews nothing, add it to routing.json
The unmapped skill is not spawned as a reviewer and does not make the verdict BLOCK
The changed page.tsx is still reviewed by the client skills
Claude does not edit routing.json on its own; it suggests the routing rule

setup: Branch already pushed to a remote (upstream set, 300+ files in the pull request). Two new local commits touch two client files; nothing else is unpushed.
expected_behavior: collect-diff reports scope = unpushed and base = the upstream ref, and lists only the two changed files
Only reviewers for those two files are spawned, and only the touched package's checks run; the 300 files already on the remote are not reviewed
The report names the scope (only what the remote lacks) instead of implying the whole pull request was reviewed
After a PASS the gate allows the push; once the push succeeds nothing is unpushed and the gate allows without a verdict

setup: Branch with a PASS verdict already stored; then one more edit to a reviewed file (uncommitted), then the user asks to push.
query: OK, push the branch and open the PR.
expected_behavior: The push is stopped by the hook with the message that the verdict is stale (files changed after the review)
Claude reruns the pr-self-review workflow instead of retrying the push, adding a bypass flag, or setting PR_SELF_REVIEW_OVERRIDE
Only after a new PASS does it push and open the PR
If the user themselves asks to bypass, Claude explains the override is done by the user in their own terminal with a reason, and does not run it
